title: Annotated Gemini orbital photo #10: San Pedro Valley, Willcox playa and Bisbee area
description: Black-and-white orbital terrain photograph on a white mount card, marked "#10" with "N" at top. Handwritten labels include "So. Pacific RR", "Willcox (playa)", "San Pedro", "Miller Peak", "Bisbee" and "Douglas". Faint vertical streaks and scratches cross the print.
